access_boundary: This record represents the GPT-4 Turbo release identified by the dated snapshot gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09, announced November 2023. OpenAI announced its deprecation and documents the shutdown date of October 23, 2026 with GPT-5.6 Sol as the recommended replacement. The later GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, and GPT-5 family lines, the OpenAI platform, and ChatGPT remain separate product or service boundaries.
strengths: OpenAI documents the pinned snapshot, deprecation date, and recommended replacement first-party
A 128,000-token context window with image input is documented
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
Access ends at the documented shutdown date
